card.name: Overdose section openings and antidote wording
card.fires_on: Words inside the OVERDOSAGE section of a drug label: the comma after "in case of overdose", the word "Treatment" right after the heading, and "specific" before antidote or antagonist.

modes.label: Comma after overdose phrase
modes.description: A comma ending an opening clause such as "in case of overdose" or "secondary to oxycodone overdose".
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE In case of overdose<<,>> the patient should be monitored for any signs

modes.label: Treatment right after heading
modes.description: The word Treatment placed directly after the OVERDOSAGE heading.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE<< Treatment>> of acute overdose is by supportive and sympt

modes.label: Specific antagonist or antidote
modes.description: The word specific describing naloxone or nalmefene as an antidote.
modes.example: The opioid antagonists, naloxone or nalmefene, are<< specific>> antidotes to respiratory depression resulting from opioid
